title: Plan-Length Schedule for Pre-K Tuition Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** Under the plan-length schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the open balance of a Pre-K tuition account under a payment plan (the enrollment's tuition charges, late fees and refunds less its payments and credits) is divided into the following number of installments:

| Open balance | Installments |
|---|---|
| 1,000.00 or more | 4 |
| 500.00 or more but less than 1,000.00 | 3 |
| less than 500.00 | 2 |

## Boundary balances (hypothetical)

| Open balance | Installments |
|---|---|
| 1000.00 | 4 |
| 999.99 | 3 |
| 500.00 | 3 |
| 499.99 | 2 |
